events.title: Heir of the Dog Launches 29th October
events.summary: Heir of the Dog launches 29th OctoberWe’re excited to announce that our highly anticipated pixel art point-and-click adventure, Heir of the Dog, is landing on Steam on October 29, with console releases already in the pipeline.Our second commercial adventure follows the success of our critically acclaimed debut, Lucy Dreaming (2022), which earned an 87 Metacritic score and currently holds a 98% positive rating on Steam.The origins of Heir of the Dog stretch back to AdventureXJam 2020, when we cre

events.title: Meet the Dev for Curious Odyssey
events.summary: As part of the Curious Odyssey Steam Sale, I wanted to play through some of the demo of Heir of the Dog and give people a chance to meet the developer behind this point & click adventure. Watch the stream, and play the demo of Heir of the Dog and enjoy a 40% discount on Lucy Dreaming!

events.title: Heir of the Dog Behind the scenes - Curious Odyssey Sale 2026
events.summary: Curious Odyssey (Mar 11-18 2026) celebrates all things cerebral, video game narratives and puzzles which engage the player and really make them think!For the event, we had a chat with Laura Cress (@Cressup) about the behind the scenes development of our pixel-art point and click adventure games... we talked about our first title, Lucy Dreaming (which will be on sale during the event) and our upcoming game, Heir of the Dog, which is currently in development. events.title: AdventureX 2025 - Day #15
events.summary: Broadcast during the AdventureX 2025 Steam sale.AdventureX is the UK's only convention dedicated to narrative-driven gaming. Since 2011, AdventureX has been bringing together developers & gamers with a passion for interactive storytelling. I have been fortunate enough to both exhibit and speak at the convention. AdventureX 2025 is happening in London on 22-23 November, and their official Steam Sale contains a huge collection of narrative adventure games.Check it out here!
